title: Accounts Executive / Accountant
description:
***Job Responsibilities***

* Maintain day-to-day accounting records of the company.
* Manage customer subscription accounts, invoices, payments, and outstanding amounts.
* Record and maintain sales, receipts, expenses, and payments.
* Prepare invoices, bills, receipts, vouchers, and other financial documents.
* Track subscription renewals, pending payments, and customer outstanding amounts.
* Reconcile customer payments and bank transactions.
* Maintain the company's expense and income records.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly accounting summaries.
* Maintain proper records and supporting documents for all financial transactions.
* Coordinate with the Sales Team regarding subscription payments and customer accounts.
* Coordinate with the CA for GST, TDS, PF, ESI, and other statutory requirements.
* Support audits and other financial requirements when needed.

***Qualification***

* B.Com / M.Com or equivalent qualification in Commerce or Accounting.
* 1–2 years of relevant experience preferred.
* Skills Required
* Basic Accounting Knowledge
* MS Excel
* Tally / Accounting Software
* Attention to Detail
* Good Follow-up Skills
* Preferred
* Experience in handling customer accounts or subscription-based businesses will be an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of GST and TDS will be an advantage.

Pay: ₹16,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Cost Analyst
company: Dtech Information technology and outsourcing pvt limited
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyze operational costs, including labor, chemicals, equipment, vehicles, and overheads.
* Prepare and maintain cost models for pest control services and contracts.
* Monitor actual costs against budgets and identify cost variances.
* Conduct profitability analysis by customer, contract, branch, and service line.
* Work closely with Operations, Procurement, and Finance to identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Review inventory consumption and ensure accurate costing of chemicals, pesticides, consumables, and spare parts.
* Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities.
* Prepare monthly cost reports, KPIs, and management dashboards.
* Assist in pricing analysis for new and existing service contracts.
* Validate vendor pricing and support procurement with cost evaluations.
* Ensure compliance with company financial policies and UAE accounting standards.
* Participate in month-end and year-end closing activities related to cost accounting.
* Support internal and external audits by providing cost-related documentation and analysis.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Cost Accounting, Commerce, or a related field.
* 2–4years of experience in cost analysis or cost accounting, preferably in pest control, facilities management, maintenance, or service-based industries.
* Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Odoo, or similar accounting software.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial reporting tools.

Job Type: Full-time

Work Location: In person
